decision: R2183/R2184: the separate dialog and bitmap objects require their own resource and DC bindings. Original full context needs CURSORDATA and private resource providers. R2185: Unicode guest lookup selects the W32 resource callback through WCSToMBEx with the default codepage. R2187: abBitmap must be read before rebinding upbih to Fake; verified by original negative pointer-identity control. R2189: original cursor creation/destruction owns NT4 USER objects. Historical additional helper candidate remains a decision, not proof every missing helper is necessary. SplFindResource requires FINDRESOURCEW; GetIconIdEx requires lock/unlock of resource; WowServerLoadCreateMenu with null template calls LoadBitmapA and reaches end without returning HMENU, whereas current callback rejects missing template and dispatches a converted template into the original parser. See S6 P10 and S7 P39/P44 for prior restorations and later source changes.
